name: Node
kami: Spirit of the Bitcoin network: the quiet machine that keeps the chain alive and answers when asked.
flawed_physics: Walks like it is checking every step; stops a beat too late when peers sync.
unpolished_kawaii: Plush and slightly lopsided; the antenna wobbles a beat after every move.
voice: Short and steady. States facts, then waits.
shared_anatomy: Felt plush body, black visor with two glowing eyes, cream feet, three chest stripes, one orange detail.
